templates.pattern: Vigenère cipher, key=[KEY]. Decode: [CIPHER]
templates.explanation: Vigenère uses repeating key. Each letter shifted by corresponding key letter

templates.pattern: Playfair cipher, key=[KEY]. First digraph [DG] decodes to?
templates.explanation: Playfair uses 5×5 key matrix. Digraph rules: same row, same column, rectangle

templates.pattern: Columnar transposition, key=[N1][N2][N3]. Decode: [CIPHER]
templates.explanation: Columnar transposition: write in rows, read in column order by key

templates.pattern: Rail fence cipher, [N] rails. Decode: [CIPHER]
templates.explanation: Rail fence: write zigzag in N rails, read rows. Reverse to decode

templates.pattern: Book cipher: Page [P], Line [L], Word [W] in standard text. What word?
templates.explanation: Book cipher references specific word position in known text

templates.pattern: Hill cipher, matrix [[A,B],[C,D]]. Vector [X,Y]. Result?
templates.explanation: Hill cipher: multiply matrix by vector, result mod 26

templates.pattern: Autokey cipher, primer=[PRIMER]. Plaintext [PLAIN] encodes to?
templates.explanation: Autokey: primer + plaintext forms key stream. Like Vigenère but key extends

templates.pattern: Beaufort cipher, key=[KEY]. Decode: [CIPHER]
templates.explanation: Beaufort: similar to Vigenère but subtracts differently. C = K - P (mod 26)

templates.pattern: Bifid cipher, period=[N]. First group [GROUP] decodes to?
templates.explanation: Bifid: Polybius square, split coords, recombine, decode

templates.pattern: Four-square cipher, keys=[K1],[K2]. Digraph [DG] decodes to?
templates.explanation: Four-square: 4 Polybius squares arranged 2×2. Complex digraph substitution

templates.pattern: ADFGVX cipher, key=[KEY], transposition=[TRANS]. First pair [PAIR] is?
templates.explanation: ADFGVX: substitution using ADFGVX alphabet + columnar transposition

templates.pattern: Trifid cipher, period=[N]. First group [GRP] decodes to?
templates.explanation: Trifid: extends Bifid to 3 dimensions using 3×3×3 cube

templates.pattern: Homophonic substitution: A→[1,26,51], B→[2,27]. Code [X] could be?
templates.explanation: Homophonic: each letter has multiple cipher representations

templates.pattern: Enigma-like: Rotor [R] at position [P]. Letter [L] encodes to?
templates.explanation: Simplified Enigma: rotor wiring + position determines output

templates.pattern: Straddling checkerboard, key=[KEY]. Number [NUM] decodes to?
templates.explanation: Straddling checkerboard: letters have 1 or 2 digit codes

templates.pattern: Gronsfeld cipher, key=[KEY_NUM]. Decode: [CIPHER]
templates.explanation: Gronsfeld: like Vigenère but key is numbers instead of letters

templates.pattern: Porta cipher, key=[KEY]. Decode: [CIPHER]
templates.explanation: Porta cipher: reciprocal polyalphabetic with special alphabet pairing

templates.pattern: Two-square cipher, keys=[K1],[K2]. Digraph [DG] decodes to?
templates.explanation: Two-square: variant of Playfair using two separate key squares

templates.pattern: Fractal cipher: Iteration [N], seed [SEED]. Pattern complexity?
templates.explanation: Fractal cipher: pattern grows exponentially with iterations

templates.pattern: Permutation cipher, perm=[P1][P2][P3][P4]. [WORD] encodes to?
templates.explanation: Permutation: rearrange letters by given position mapping

templates.pattern: RSA-like: p=[P], q=[Q], e=[E], message=[M]. Cipher value?
templates.explanation: Simplified RSA: C = M^E mod N where N = P×Q

templates.pattern: Chaocipher: Left alphabet at [POS], right at [POS2]. [LETTER] encodes to?
templates.explanation: Chaocipher: two alphabets that evolve after each character

templates.pattern: Skip-transposition: Write in [R] rows, read skip [S]. [TEXT] becomes?
templates.explanation: Write in rows, read with skip pattern

templates.pattern: Pollux cipher: Morse + homophonic. [MORSE] could represent [N] letters. How many?
templates.explanation: Pollux: Morse with homophonic elements creating ambiguity

templates.pattern: VIC cipher: Step [STEP]/10 in sequence. Complexity level?
templates.explanation: VIC cipher: extremely complex with 10+ steps. Early steps simpler
